dedupe_keys.name: dataset from a smart factory for activity detection using temporal case based reasoning

description: Ronny Seiger and collaborators publish labelled factory IoT segments and activity signatures for temporal case-based recognition. The free Zenodo ZIP uses CC BY 4.0. It contains raw JSONL observations, analyst-derived signatures, segmented activity data, Camunda process logs, storage and production BPMN definitions, and reference confusion matrices. These files can test activity-recognition components used to reconstruct manufacturing processes for simulation. Related G6 data-stgallen-factory-six-process-iot-event-logs describes another experiment on the same demonstrator; equivalence of the observation sessions is not established. Coverage is the study’s controlled factory activities, with exact dates and sample counts unknown. Filenames carry expected labels, so evaluation must avoid accidentally exposing those labels to a predictor. Segmentation and analyst judgements introduce uncertainty. No archive was downloaded, case library trained or reported classifier accuracy reproduced.
